C1569.title: Remeasuring the Arbitrage and Sandwich Attacks of Maximal Extractable Value in Ethereum
C1569.summary: This academic study examines how block producers on the Ethereum blockchain can extract additional value by strategically including, excluding, or reordering transactions within a block, a practice known as maximal extractable value (MEV).
